_comment: Performance regression baseline for @vytches/ddd-di (U-5/E). Update this file after intentional optimisations by running `pnpm --filter @vytches/ddd-di bench` and committing the new results.json alongside updated baseline values.

singleton_us_per_op.description: Warmed singleton resolve must complete in < 1 µs/op

transient_us_per_op.description: Warmed transient resolve (new instance each call) must complete in < 2 µs/op

string_token_singleton_us_per_op.description: String-token singleton resolve (common real-world pattern) must complete in < 1 µs/op

kb_per_descriptor_singleton.description: Heap delta per registered singleton descriptor must be < 1 KB

kb_per_descriptor_transient.description: Heap delta per registered transient descriptor must be < 1 KB

notes: SLOs are library-isolated; no NestJS or framework overhead is included.
Memory deltas are approximate: process.memoryUsage() reflects the entire heap, not just descriptors.
GC timing can cause transient spikes; run 3+ times and take the median.
results.json (generated by vitest bench --outputJson) contains the raw timing data.
